verdict: CDW sales jumped 18% to $6.75B on enterprise AI demand — financial-services sales alone rose 73% — though a richer hardware mix trimmed gross margin to 20.5%.

kpis.label: Revenue growth
kpis.note: Net sales were $6,754M, vs $5,737M a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: up 12% YoY; non-GAAP EPS was $3.26, up 20%

kpis.label: Commercial sales
kpis.note: up 21% YoY — CDW's largest customer group

kpis.label: Gross margin
kpis.note: down from 21.9% — mix shifted toward lower-margin hardware

segments.name: Commercial
segments.note: Sales to businesses: Corporate $2,606M (+17%), Healthcare $802M (+9%) and Financial Services $572M (+73%).

segments.name: Government
segments.note: Sales to federal, state and local government.

segments.name: Other (UK & Canada)
segments.note: CDW's UK and Canadian operations, reported together.

opex.name: Selling & administrative
opex.note: Sales teams, services staff and running the company — up 10% YoY on performance pay, workplace-optimization and acquisition costs.

otherDetail: Net interest expense was $66M — interest on borrowings, net of interest earned — partly offset by less than $1M of other income; shown as a net $65M cost after rounding.
oneTimers: Non-GAAP operating income was $620M vs $490M GAAP — the roughly $130M gap is mainly stock-based pay, amortization and the workplace-optimization and acquisition costs CDW excludes from its non-GAAP figures.
footerNote: Figures are rounded to $M from amounts reported to one decimal (net sales $6,754.5M; operating income $489.5M), so some lines differ by $1M from the release.

takeaways.title: Financial services went all-in on AI
takeaways.text: Sales to financial-services customers rose 73% YoY. Demand centered on data storage, servers, notebooks and software as enterprises build out AI infrastructure.

takeaways.title: Growth came at thinner margins
takeaways.text: Gross margin fell to 20.5% from 21.9% because the mix shifted into lower-margin product categories — gross profit still grew 10% to $1,385M on the bigger sales base.

takeaways.title: Buybacks amplified EPS
takeaways.text: Non-GAAP EPS rose 20% to $3.26, faster than profit growth, because buybacks cut diluted shares to 126M from 132M a year ago. CDW also declared a $0.68 quarterly dividend.
